title: IndexedDB session state rows are never pruned
reason: Reports an unused pruning method in tldraw's exported LocalIndexedDb session store. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve does not use tldraw's `session_state` object store or persist a row per browser tab through the same LocalIndexedDb abstraction; this maintenance issue does not establish a corresponding local row-growth defect.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not use tldraw's `session_state` object store or persist a row per browser tab through the same LocalIndexedDb abstraction; this maintenance issue does not establish a corresponding local row-growth defect.

title: Export background has two conflicting defaults in tlschema
reason: Reports two tldraw defaults that currently resolve to the same initial observable transparency state because the creator supplies an explicit value. No comments were available.
assessment: This is an upstream latent schema-contract mismatch that the issue itself says has no current observable effect. Varve's export background is managed through its own explicit export options and does not share the cited tldraw instance-record defaults.

title: Debug flags panel has dead flags, a wrong slow-FPS threshold, and sticky hide shapes
reason: Reports unused toggles, refresh-rate-dependent FPS warning threshold, and a debug-mode-dependent hide-shapes flag that remains active after leaving the panel. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no matching tldraw debug flags panel or hideShapes toggle state machine. Its canvas diagnostics and frame timing use separate metrics, so the upstream dead-flag and threshold defects do not identify the same local path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no matching tldraw debug flags panel or hideShapes toggle state machine. Its canvas diagnostics and frame timing use separate metrics, so the upstream dead-flag and threshold defects do not identify the same local path.

title: Auto input mode is mislabelled and note shadows are missing from dark-mode exports
reason: Combines a wheel input-mode label based on application configuration rather than device detection with a dark-export note-shadow report. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve labels wheel modes as explicit Auto/Pan/Zoom choices and the new invert-zoom preference describes the actual direction behavior; it does not label Auto as a detected mouse or trackpad. Varve has no tldraw note shape/shadow export path matching the second report.

title: Links cannot be added, edited, or removed on touch devices
reason: Reports a tldraw coarse-pointer path hiding its rich-text toolbar and therefore its inline link editor. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's rich-text editing and link controls are structured around its own text editing surfaces and link properties; the hidden DefaultRichTextToolbar/LinkEditor nesting described upstream is absent. Touch reachability of Varve's link workflows should be evaluated on its own interaction contract rather than inferred from this code path.

title: Rich text copy, paste, and link handling inconsistencies
reason: Aggregates tldraw plain-text list serialization, paste-time markdown, URL scheme defaults, shortcut casing, RTL list, and export inconsistencies. No comments were available.
assessment: The report spans separate upstream rich-text policies; Varve uses a different document/text representation and clipboard pipeline. No single Varve behavior can be inferred from the tldraw discrepancies, so retain individual product comparisons rather than porting the aggregate fix as a unit.

title: Outbox insert effect for a duplicated file hangs until parked with no error
reason: Describes a tldraw hosted outbox effect timing out while waiting for a shared Durable Object persist and a linked server-side bound/failure-stage fix. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve is a local-first editor and does not have the hosted shared-file outbox/R2 duplication path described; this incident is outside the current product boundary.

title: Add native Mermaid support for entity relationship diagrams (erDiagram)
reason: Requests editable entity and relationship shapes when Mermaid ER syntax is pasted; upstream currently inserts a static SVG for unsupported diagram types. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no Mermaid import/conversion feature or existing static-SVG fallback for Mermaid input, so this is a potential product feature rather than a local regression. It would require a defined diagram-import contract and entity/relationship node conversion.

title: Add PDF export for pages and whole files on tldraw.com
reason: Requests a single PDF with one page per design page using full page content bounds; the sole comment additionally requests PDF export from frames for presentation preparation.
assessment: Varve already exports multi-page presentation slides as PDF, while native document PDF export is focused on print/output geometry. Whole-file design-page export and frame-as-PDF-page workflow are distinct feature requests and should be assessed against those existing products rather than treated as missing PDF support generally.

title: Add hexagonal grid option (flat-top and pointy-top)
reason: Requests flat-top and pointy-top hex grids for tabletop maps; grid snapping/shared-grid requirements remain open. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve supports document and isometric grid systems but not hexagonal grid geometry. This is a potential cross-cutting grid feature, not a bug fix; the user story and unresolved snap/consistency requirements need a separate scoped feature decision before implementation.
